policy.unit: One resolved stem spelling and source-listed gender; retain every contributing source analysis.
policy.compound_handling: Remove any row with a source-marked compound/derivational boundary; the current basic/nyap adapter does not represent it.
policy.feminine_stems: Resolve supported explicit hints and implicit a-to-A formation; audit unresolved formations.
policy.engine_constructors: Reviewed basic/nyap classes; every retained row is instantiated in VP 0.4.0 and checked for spelling, flags, and gender-enum mapping.
policy.task_generation: None. No case-number or 175-affix enumeration, derivations, answers, or prompts.
policy.deduplication: Stem and gender; a row is removed if any contributing source interpretation is unsupported. Retained rows are unchanged.
policy.validation_limit: Supported representation in the current adapter, not independent linguistic certification or a guarantee for every taddhita affix. Taddhitanta gender/meaning and known suffix-specific constructor behavior still need task-level validation.

exclusion_reasons.special_lexical_metadata: LEXID/INFLECTID notation needs a separate interpretation of stems and genders.
exclusion_reasons.indeclinable: The source lists an indeclinable, not a masculine/feminine/neuter entry.
exclusion_reasons.unsupported_descriptor: The descriptor is outside the supported gender/hint notation.
exclusion_reasons.invalid_headword_encoding: The headword is not losslessly renderable SLP1.
exclusion_reasons.unresolved_stem_hint: The explicit stem hint has no supported replacement rule for this headword.
exclusion_reasons.unresolved_feminine_stem: This ending needs additional feminine-stem formation rules; do not copy the headword as the feminine stem.
exclusion_reasons.invalid_stem_encoding: The resolved stem is not losslessly renderable SLP1.
exclusion_reasons.vp_unsupported_input: The resolved row failed the supported VP representation checks; see vp_reasons and the VP exclusion file.

vp_exclusion_reasons.compound_boundary: The current basic/nyap adapter does not represent the source's compound/derivational boundaries.
vp_exclusion_reasons.source_notation: The extended source spelling needs interpretation beyond a bare headword.
vp_exclusion_reasons.special_lexical_metadata: This headword also has LEXID/INFLECTID metadata requiring a richer grammatical representation.
vp_exclusion_reasons.ambiguous_feminine_class: The source gives competing feminine inflection-class hints for this headword.
vp_exclusion_reasons.unresolved_feminine_class: The feminine stem needs a richer constructor or an unreviewed interpretation.
vp_exclusion_reasons.unsupported_stem_class: The stem falls outside the reviewed basic/nyap representation classes.
vp_exclusion_reasons.constructor_failure: VP could not construct the selected representation while preserving its spelling and flags.
